messages.subject: shading between lines
parts:
Hi,
Say I have a plot like below:

c<-data.frame(position=(1:20), a=rnorm(1:20), b=rnorm(1:20))

ggplot(data=c, aes(position)) + geom_line(aes(y=a), colour="1")
+geom_line(aes(y=b), colour="2")

How can I shade only between the lines and only when line 1 is above
line 2?

Many thanks,
Squid.
